A '''Jolly Meal''' was a well-known [[Biscuit Baron]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] bundle for young [[Youngling/Legends|children]]. [[Wrenga Jixton|Jix]] made reference to one in his report to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].
